fields.name: sprite
fields.note: boot: sub_18BB80 draws it (sub_115AD0) for kind 1

fields.name: active
fields.note: boot: sub_18B700 returns 0 while it is 0; sub_18BC10 sets 1

fields.name: kind
fields.note: boot: sub_18B700: 0 -> sub_18BB20, 1 -> sub_18BB80

fields.name: motion curve
fields.note: boot: sub_18B7B0 jump table: 0 jump, 1 linear, 2 sine, 3 cosine

fields.name: fade curve
fields.note: boot: sub_18BA60 jump table: 0 none, 1 out, 2 in

fields.name: sprite frame
fields.note: boot: sub_18BB80 -> sub_115AD0

fields.name: frame
fields.note: boot: sub_18B700 counts it up to the last frame (test_boot_panels)

fields.name: first frame
fields.note: boot: nothing is drawn before it

fields.name: x
fields.note: boot: sub_18BB20 / sub_18BB80 store the current position

fields.name: alpha
fields.note: boot: the current alpha byte (sub_18BA60)

fields.name: slide state
fields.note: boot: sub_18DE60: 0 start, 1 sliding in, 2 reset, 3 standing

fields.name: slot
fields.note: boot: 0 the hero, 1..3 party slots (sub_16DD60(slot - 1))

fields.name: mode
fields.note: boot: sub_18DB20 jump table: 0 normal, 1 simple, 2 flash, 3 mark in, 4 mark

fields.name: mode after flash
fields.note: boot: sub_18DDE0 kind 3 saves the mode here; sub_18D320 restores it

fields.name: unit
fields.note: boot: read as a halfword (lh) by the member draws

fields.name: spark timer
fields.note: boot: sub_18C150, mod 100

fields.name: tween
fields.note: boot: TweenRecord (sub_18B6D0(1))

fields.name: name
fields.note: boot: sub_18E5C0 strcpy; drawn by sub_3B2CB0

fields.name: tweens
fields.note: boot: three TweenRecords (sub_18B6D0(10))

fields.name: area sprite file
fields.note: boot: *0x7CE008 (camp/areapnl.pak)
